auth.token_lifetime: Access token 60 minutes (expires_in); refresh token 60 days (refresh_expires_in)
auth.refresh: POST https://airtable.com/oauth2/v1/token with grant_type=refresh_token; each refresh invalidates the previous access and refresh tokens and returns new ones; refreshing within every 60 days keeps the grant alive indefinitely. PKCE (S256, 43-128 char verifier) is mandatory on the authorization request.

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: None: status file notes Airtable does not review third-party OAuth integrations; support email, privacy and terms URLs are set so other users may authorize it
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Airtable user authorizes the LOVELEEDAY integration and picks the workspaces and bases it may read.

sandbox.how_to_get: No sandbox; free Airtable account used for testing

rate_limits: 5 requests/second per base; 50 requests/second per user or service account for personal access token traffic; 429 requires waiting 30 seconds before requests succeed again; Airtable reserves the right to change limits by plan

events: UNVERIFIED (webhook:manage scope exists; event list not fetched)

incremental_sync: List records has no native last-modified filter; use filterByFormula on a last-modified-time field (workaround stated in docs); pageSize up to 100 with offset pagination; POST list recommended for formulas over 16,000 URL characters
blockers: Incremental sync depends on the customer having a last-modified-time field in each table; otherwise a full re-read per sync.
5 requests/second per base caps large backfills.
The client secret was visible once in a screenshot image during registration (status file); rotate if that image is not trusted.
